items.title: Physical Natural Gas Prices Pop as Far-Reaching Heat Dome Galvanizes Buyers
items.summary: Next-day natural gas prices cruised higher on Tuesday as buyers stocked up to address current heat blasts and expectations for more in the week ahead.

items.title: Southern Heat, Bullish Storage Expectations Fuel Natural Gas Futures
items.summary: Natural gas futures mustered momentum on Tuesday as traders focused on hardy mid-August cooling demand and expectations for a seasonally lean storage injection.

items.title: Natural Gas Production Lurches Higher as LNG Buildout Beckons
items.summary: US natural gas production has trended notably higher in August, helping to limit price rallies and ease supply concerns ahead of an expected rebound in LNG feedgas demand.

items.title: ExxonMobil Green Lights Some Equipment for Rovuma LNG Project
items.summary: ExxonMobil this week awarded several pre-final investment decision (FID) contracts for long-lead time equipment at its Rovuma LNG project in Mozambique targeted for startup next decade.

items.title: Dog Days Not Over Yet as Late Summer Heat Keeps Natural Gas Futures Afloat
items.summary: Tightening supply and robust near-term power demand helped natural gas futures edge higher intraday on Tuesday, erasing the previous session’s losses.

items.title: First Nations-Led Kino Aski LNG Revives Quebec Export Ambitions
items.summary: An Indigenous-led group and Marinvest Energy Canada are reviving ambitions for an LNG export facility on the Atlantic coast of Canada with a 15 Mt/y proposed project targeting European demand.

items.title: Lower 48 Power Generation Nears Record as Natural Gas-Fired Output Hits 267 GW
items.summary: Preliminary data put total Lower 48 power generation within 0.1 GW of its all-time weekly high during the latest storage week, even as stronger wind and solar output kept natural gas-fired generation about 2% below its own record.
